# The OpenPGP header cleanup replaces three consumers with structured MIME parameter access

Verify and encrypt add Content-Type: before calling extractHeaders; Exchange repair passes its existing full header line. Consumers retrieve content-type then parameter values through get, with scoped empty defaults. The encryption branch still computes an unused boundary and marks it FIXME; the cleanup does not make that value affect output. The wrapper parses only envelope headers synchronously. The review’s quoted-header thought remains uncertain, and no malformed-message or crypto test ran.

Scope: OpenPGP structured header parsing boundary.
